units.passage: Completing group work assigned to a student, unless it is mutually agreed upon that they may utilize the tool.
units.policy: Generative AI tools are not permitted for completing group work assigned to a student, unless it is mutually agreed upon that they may utilize the tool.
units.why: AI is not permitted for "Completing group work assigned to a student, unless it is mutually agreed upon that they may utilize the tool." A group-work rule, P127.

units.passage: Group Work: Group work guidelines are based on the type of assignment above (e.g., a group written assignment will use the guidelines for written assignments).
units.why: Sets AI rules for group work by tying them to the assignment type ('a group written assignment will use the guidelines for written assignments'): P127.
